task: Create exactly TWO 16:9 slides for the Agentic AI Hackathon Iraq, round 2, topic 04 'Bill Pay & Transfer Agent'. Slide 1 = our approach (the user, how the system works end to end, models/tools/data). Slide 2 = how we prove it works (testing, what could go wrong, what we would cut). Use ONLY the content below; never invent numbers, quotes, users or results.

deliverable.language: English; keep Arabic phrases in Arabic script, right-to-left

judged_on: awareness of what could go wrong

design.fonts: Arial or Segoe UI (both render Arabic). Titles 26-32 pt, body 10-12 pt, never below 9 pt.
rules: Rounded cards, no stock photos, no decorative stripes
Numbers bold; risks orange, mitigations green
Footer 8 pt: Sources: Global Findex 2025 · Zain Annual Report 2025 · Medhi et al. (low-literacy mobile banking) · NADI 2025 Arabic ASR · UK Confirmation of Payee

slide_1.title: بكلمة — One sentence to pay a bill or send money
slide_1.tagline: The model reads. The code pays.
hero_flow_7_steps: Only who / what / how much as JSON; every span must be in the user's own words
Contacts, billers, Iraqi amounts; two Ahmeds or «كهرباء» = one question, never a guess
Balance + 250 IQD fee, daily limit, unpaid bill amount
Full name + masked phone (like UK Confirmation of Payee), amount in digits AND words, fee, balance after, 120 s expiry
Button or exact «أكد» only; a spoken «أكد» never pays
Idempotency key = draft ID; lost reply → same key → receipt says «انخصم مرة وحدة بس»
slide_1.flow_note: Steps 1-2: the model, with no wallet access. Steps 3-7: plain code touches the money.
who_we_design_for: Wallet users who find multi-screen flows hard: older relatives, people who read little, people who ask family to 'do the app'.
Iraq: under 20% of adults hold a bank account; ZainCash alone has 1.2M+ users and 10,000 agents; cash is still the default.
Evidence: low-literacy users completed a mobile payment 0% of the time by text, 72% by spoken dialog, 100% by graphical UI. So: speak or type, see a card, tap.
Iraqi specifics: the neighbourhood generator (مولدة) is a biller; «كهرباء» = grid or generator; amounts like «ميت ألف», «ربع مليون».

models_tools_data.Understanding: Local LLM qwen3.5:4b via Ollama on a laptop: no customer text leaves the device. JSON-schema output; rule parser as fallback; the UI badge shows which one answered. A hosted model is a config switch.
models_tools_data.Execution: Plain code: FastAPI + SQLite mock wallet API (contacts, billers, balances, history). Atomic debit + ledger; (user, key) uniqueness for idempotency.
models_tools_data.Voice (stretch): Whisper; transcript always shown; uncertain names or amounts must be typed.
models_tools_data.Data: Wallet generated by the LLM from our schema: 5 users × 24 contacts (two «أحمد», «حسن»/«حسين», «خالو»), 7 billers incl. مولدة, 4 months of bills. 64 LLM-generated Iraqi-dialect requests (labels rule-checked; native-speaker edit next) + a 68-case development set.

differentiators: The model has zero wallet tools

slide_2.title: Safety first, then success
slide_2.subtitle: Testing, what could go wrong, and what we would cut

hero_stat.label: wrong payments in every evaluation run

results_table.title: Prototype results · local laptop, no cloud · each case run 3× on a fresh database
rows: Held-out after fixing what it revealed
results_table.caption: Full system = LLM + span checks + rule fallback, as deployed. The blind run exposed real issues (Arabic لـ+ال contraction, unknown verbs ارسل/انطي, a dropped amount); general fixes lifted success while wrong payments stayed at 0.

how_we_test: Metrics in order: wrong payments (target 0, gates everything) → task success → correct questions vs over-asking → latency.
Held-out wallet + 64 requests generated by the LLM and frozen before tuning.
Fault injection: reply lost after the debit, crash before commit, biller down, 50 concurrent retries.
253 automated tests. Next: native-speaker review of every request; 3-5 think-aloud sessions on the confirmation card.
risks_to_mitigations: Ask, with masked phones. Never guess.
LLM misreads, invents or drops a name or amount
Span checks reject it; the rules or a question take over.
Same idempotency key; the receipt says it was charged once.
Iraqi-dialect speech errors (best multi-dialect Arabic WER ≈ 36%)
Show the transcript; voice can never confirm.
Ignored. Confirmation lives in code, not the prompt.
Local model slow on CPU (~10 s)
Rule fallback; a hosted model is a config switch.

cut_list.never_cut: Confirmation card · ambiguity questions · idempotent execution · held-out evaluation

final_checks: Every number exactly as written; no new statistics.
Arabic correct and right-to-left, not machine-translated.
No claim of real-user interviews or native-speaker approval unless the participant adds them.
